name: aWATTar Market Data (hourly day-ahead prices)
summary: Keyless JSON API for hourly day-ahead electricity spot prices in Germany and Austria, in EUR per MWh with millisecond timestamps.
description: A single endpoint, /v1/marketdata, returns hourly day-ahead market prices as a list of {start_timestamp, end_timestamp, marketprice, unit} objects. Without parameters it returns the coming hours (up to about 24 hours ahead); start and end in epoch milliseconds select past ranges. Separate hosts serve Germany (api.awattar.de) and Austria (api.awattar.at).

auth.notes: The docs page states that no access token has been required since 2020-07-20.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the page fetched; responses send Cache-Control max-age=120 and expose Retry-After headers for CORS.

endpoints.summary: Hourly market prices (next hours by default, or a range)

license.name: Not stated on the API docs page

coverage.temporal: Past ranges via start and end, plus the coming day

agent_notes: Timestamps are epoch milliseconds. marketprice is EUR per MWh as sent (unit field says Eur/MWh); whether it is net of VAT was not stated in the docs fetched, so check before showing consumer prices. Use api.awattar.at for Austria. The docs are in German; the German domain's docs page now redirects to energy.tado.com.
caveats: No licence or terms were found for the data; treat reuse as unclear.
The DE docs URL redirects to energy.tado.com/services/api (aWATTar is now part of tado); the Austrian page https://www.awattar.at/services/api was the one fetched.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; a no-UA and a curl-UA request returned 200 on the default endpoint.
